capabilities: Write flashcards in notes using basic, single-line, reversed, cloze, image occlusion, type-in, and whole-note formats
Schedule reviews with the FSRS-5 algorithm and configurable parameters and daily limits
Review due cards in a dashboard with custom study sessions filtered by tag, card state, or limit
Track learning with retention curves, maturity distribution, interval histograms, and activity stats
Sync review data across devices via a self-hosted CouchDB and back it up as JSON
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents community-plugin-scanner disclosures (vault enumeration, localStorage use), warns that the CouchDB password is stored unencrypted in data.json, and recommends a dedicated CouchDB user with an https:// URL.
intentEvidence: Most spaced repetition tools require leaving your knowledge base, exporting notes, and managing a secondary database.
motivation: The author built it to embed spaced repetition directly in Markdown so users never have to export notes or manage a secondary database; review history stays local or on the user's own CouchDB.
problem: Spaced repetition tools typically require leaving the knowledge base and managing a separate app or database, and standard Obsidian SR plugins vary in FSRS support, mobile use, and custom study sessions.

relations.evidence: Lemma uses FSRS-5 (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler, via ts-fsrs)
Optionally connect your own CouchDB or Cloudant instance to sync it across devices

summary: Flashcard plugin that stores cards as plain Markdown inside notes and schedules reviews with the FSRS-5 spaced repetition algorithm.
